changes: Added hard-coded runtime and process drift gates: runtime reviewer and main-branch runtime health now derive the CLI from the current checkout and scan scripts for both full hardcoded worktree CLI paths and split worktreeRoot+join regressions; process fact contract now fails prompt/template reviewRound:number drift; silent catch audit now uses a committed v2 line-stable baseline and hard-fails new uncategorized catches; prompts/docs now state fresh-worker and user-value evidence boundaries explicitly.
usage: Run npm run test:runtime-reviewer-contract, node scripts/verify-main-branch-runtime-health.mjs, npm run test:process-fact-contract, npm run audit:silent-catches, and koala validate --story=B-8960. audit:silent-catches reports baseline version, debt count, newUncategorized, and lineStableBaselineKey.
expectedOutcome: Maintainer commands verify Koala process facts mechanically: runtime path drift is caught, reviewRound numeric prompt drift is caught, silent-catch debt is baseline-gated, and prompt-only fresh-worker or user-value claims are not accepted as hard evidence.
actualTranscript: runtime reviewer contract verified; main branch runtime health verified; Process fact contract verified; audit:silent-catches printed status silent catch audit passed with baseline version 2, newUncategorized 0, lineStableBaselineKey passed; negative temp catch produced silent catch audit failed with newUncategorized 1; npm test printed ALL PASS; koala validate reported Verification intent coverage 15/15 covered.
outcomeDiff: No remaining product-visible gap. Worktree validation needed a local packages/main/node_modules symlink because npm ci cannot resolve unpublished @koala-agent/lab, but no tracked files were modified.
limitations: True subagent context isolation and final subjective user approval cannot be fully mechanically proven; Koala now encodes the observable evidence boundaries and rejects prompt-only proof claims. Existing 501 uncategorized catches remain tracked baseline debt.
pitfalls: Quality review found two important false-hardening risks: scanning only full CLI path literals missed split worktreeRoot+join regressions, and file:line:snippet baseline keys caused line-number false positives. Both are now covered by synthetic/source tests and v2 line-stable baseline keys.
